hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The majority of the crypto basket shows flat or weak signals with negative composites, negative alpha, and elevated volatility. Liquidity scores for BTC, ETH, SOL and especially LTC are below neutral, and the institutional advisory risk is high (0.65). These factors point to a fragile market environment, so we tilt the fund toward a risk‑off posture and scale down overall exposure. The long‑biased altcoins have placeholder risk metrics (zero vol, zero ES) and therefore merit only modest, cautious conviction nudges.
